senses.gloss: † कङ्क् कङ्क्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.

कङ्क कङ्क,
 I. m.
 1. A heron, Rām. 6, 90, 25.
 2. The name of a king, MBh. 1, 227.
 3. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 2, 1850.
 II. f. का, A proper name, Hariv. 2029.
कङ्कट कङ्कट (for कङ्कत्र, from the base कञ्च्, cf. कञ्चुक), m. Mail, Rām. 5, 80, 32.

कङ्कण कङ्कण (a reduplicated from of कण्, and aff. अ), m. and n.
 1. An ornament, MBh. 3, 15757.
 2. A bracelet, Bhartṛ. 2, 63.
 3. The name of a certain weapon, Rām. 1, 29, 13; 56, 12 (Gorr. has किङ्किणी, q. cf.).
कङ्कणिन् कङ्कणिन्, i. e. कङ्कण + इन्, adj., f. नी, Wearing a bracelet, Kathās. 22, 91.
कङ्कत कङ्कत (perhaps for *कङ्कर्त, i. e. an old redupl. form of कृत् and aff. अ) m., f. ती, and n. A comb, Rām. 2, 91, 70.
कङ्काल कङ्काल, m. A skeleton, Sund. 2, 24.

काङ्क्ष् काङ्क्ष् (an old desider. of कम्, *कङ्कंस्, by intermediate कङ्कस्), i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 13, 769).
 1. To wish, Bhag. 12, 17.
 2. To desire, Rām. 4, 17, 18.
 3. To wait for, MBh. 3, 414.
 4. To attend to (with the dat.), Rām. 2, 25, 43.
 काङ्क्षित, n. Desire, Rām. 5, 29, 9.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To desire, MBh. 2, 2135 (Ātm.).
 --With अभि अभि, To desire, Rām. 2, 49, 15.
 --Caus. To desire, MBh. 3, 12457.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To desire, MBh. 1, 4286.
 2. To strive for, Yājñ. 1, 153.
 3. To seek (with the gen.), Man. 2, 162.
 4. To turn towards, Man. 3, 258.
 5. To want, Man. 10, 121.
 6. To expect, Rām. 2, 5, 19.
 --With प्रत्या प्रति-आ, To expect, MBh. 12, 4870 (Ātm.); to wait for, 4, 734 (Ātm.).
 --With समा सम्-आ, To desire, MBh. 4, 1664.
 --With प्र प्र, To desire, Suśr. 1, 52, 6.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To long for, Rām. 2, 112, 12 (Ātm.).
 --With वि वि, To intend, Hariv. 13136.
 --Cf. perhaps Goth. huhru; A.S. hungor.
काङ्क्षा काङ्क्ष् + आ, f. Desire, Nal. 16, 1.
काङ्क्षिता काङ्क्षिता, i. e. काङ्क्षिन् + ता, f. Desire, Rām. 2, 34, 28.

काङ्क्षिन् काङ्क्ष् + इन्, adj., f. इणी.
 1. Desiring (with acc.), Rām. 2, 110, 20.
 2. Expecting, Rām. 5, 33, 27.
कङ्क- + तुण्ड कङ्क- + तुण्ड, m. the name of a Rākṣasa or demon, Rām. 6, 84, 13.

कङ्क- + पत्र कङ्क- + पत्र,
 I. n. the feather of a heron, Rām. 4, 7, 22.
 II. m. an arrow, Rām. 6, 28, 4.
कङ्क- + पत्रिन् कङ्क- + पत्रिन्, m. an arrow, MBh. 4, 1804.
कङ्क- + मुख कङ्क- + मुख, adj. heron-mouthed, Rām. 6, 79, 69.
कङ्काल-मुषल कङ्काल-मुषल, [] m. or n. a kind of weapon, Rām. 1, 30, 13 Gorr.; 57, 12 Gorr.
